successors.name: Republic of Indonesia
successors.text: the realm covered 'hampir 2/3 dari luas pulau Sumbawa' (western Sumbawa: Sumbawa Besar, Taliwang, Seran, Jereweh)

ledger.x: 12 June 1674: the Dewa Dalam Bawa dynasty is established after Mas Goa's removal in 1673; treaty with the VOC, claim to Selaparang given up.
1958: the dynasty's rule ends as the sultanate joins the Republic of Indonesia.
1958: sultanate ends; a sultan was re-installed ceremonially in 2011.

certainty.note: No boundary on the page; outline is modern regencies.
